admission_details.quote: Path to Paul is a one semester (fall only) pre-business program for academically promising students who don't meet the minimum academic requirements for direct admission to a Paul College of Business and Economics major. … Entering first year prospective students who apply to Paul College and are not eligible for direct admission will automatically be considered on a space available basis. … To be eligible, students must have a minimum 3.2 high school GPA. … Upon successful completion of this first semester program with a minimum 2.3 cumulative GPA students can then officially declare a Paul College major. … Minimum 2.3 cumulative GPA required.

paths.text: Direct admission to a Paul College major for entering students who meet its minimum academic requirements
Path to Paul: a one-semester (fall) pre-business program, space available, minimum 3.2 high school GPA; declare the major after a 2.3 cumulative GPA
